mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return rate drops below 55% in low-rate periods.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return rate for FEDFUNDS above 3.0% periods exceeds 45% or the Rank IC is greater than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.0% and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, the combined signal of monetary tightening and persistent inflation compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, the 60-day forward return rate exceeds 45% or the Rank IC is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), the 20-day forward return rate for declining UNRATE periods falls below 55% or the Rank IC drops below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1600.0) signal weak residential demand, which reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return rate for HOUST below 1600.0 periods exceeds 45% or the Rank IC is greater than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day S&P 500 returns falls below 0.04 in any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return rate drops below 58%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based demand slowdown that depresses corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, the 20-day forward return rate exceeds 45% or the Rank IC is above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 0.5% signals weak labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return rate for PAYEMS growth rates below 0.5% periods exceeds 45% or the Rank IC is greater than 0.02.
